comment: Added Updates page with a development log sourced from git commit messages (no repository links).
Removed the Grid right/below layout toggle from Monsters and NPCs search; layout is fixed side-by-side for now.
Escape closes entity modals the same as the close button; nested MD and image popouts close first.
Left and right arrow keys browse previous and next result rows while a detail modal stays open.
Spell, Feat, and Equipment modals now match the Monster modal layout: description pane, markdown section, field grids, and image popout support.
Split markdown description extraction: monsters use lead paragraphs; spells, feats, and equipment pull prose after the first horizontal rule.
Added NPCs as a fifth home library with its own search page and API endpoint; Monsters search excludes NPCs.
Monster art double-click opens a full-size image popout scaled to fit the viewport with margin.
Navigation bar always shows all sections including the current page, with the active page highlighted.
